findings.description: Direct inspection of current V201 renders: crouch and sit lift/open the skirt around both thighs, exposing substantial upper-thigh area with irregular triangular hem flaps. Prone produces severe skirt collapse and large garment distortion. The V201 front/side hem balancing does not maintain coverage under the required poses.

Neutral front and three-quarter views show a broad, mostly uniform A-line apron. The back view is a plain unpleated panel. The intended broad pleat channels are not visually distinct; front folds remain crushed and irregular.
The left view retains a small pointed hem projection and the right view a long tapered rear-side extension, so the hem is not continuous around the side silhouette.
The jacket torso and waist transition retain angular/crumpled faceting. In the arms-up render a gray underarm gap is visible at image-right, with uneven sleeve-root overlap.

nextAction: For V202, preserve the V201 neutral hem balance while correcting pose behavior at the garment source: constrain front panel deformation around flexed thighs and maintain a continuous lap hem for crouch and sit; solve skirt support/collision in prone instead of allowing the skirt to collapse. Author clearly separated, evenly spaced pleat channels on front and back, remove both side-end projections, and smooth jacket waist and armhole overlap. Rebuild and inspect the exact five views and six poses. Keep this candidate rejected; avatar fit, runtime, UV and release remain unverified.
